spans.s: (in gram.) a term for the Intensive suffix य, Pāṇ. iii, 1, 22 &c.
यङ्—अन्त m. the Ātmanepada Intens. formed by reduplication and the suffix य, ib. vi, 1, 9, Sch.
यङ्—लुक् the dropping of the Intensive suffix य (or a blank substituted for it), ib. ii, 4, 74
यङ्—˚लुग्-अन्त m. the Parasmaipada Intens. formed without य
